project.title: Study on the Treatment of Swine Wastewater by Algal-Bacterial Granular Sludge Based on Coagulation and Equal-Volume Dilution
project.description: This project investigates the treatment of swine wastewater using algal-bacterial granular sludge based on coagulation and equal-volume dilution. The experiment tracks three key stages: the initial sample (CS), the mid-term sample (A1), and the final sample (B1), to analyze the treatment performance and granule characteristics across these stages.
project.center_name: Wuhan University of Science and Technology
